title: Compositional engineering of perovskite materials for high-performance solar cells
finding: Compositional FA-MA engineering optimizes bandgap and crystallinity, establishing mixed A-site cations as the route to high, stable efficiency.

title: Cesium-containing triple cation perovskite solar cells: improved stability, reproducibility and high efficiency
finding: Triple-cation Cs/MA/FA absorbers are more reproducible, thermally stable and phase-robust than double-cation baselines.

title: Formamidinium lead trihalide: a broadly tunable perovskite for efficient planar heterojunction solar cells
finding: Introduces FA lead trihalide with a near-ideal ~1.48 eV gap but flags its room-temperature drift to the photoinactive hexagonal delta phase.

title: Incorporation of rubidium cations into perovskite solar cells improves photovoltaic performance
finding: Adding Rb to Cs/MA/FA gives a quadruple-cation absorber with suppressed yellow-phase impurities and improved operational stability.

title: High-efficiency two-dimensional Ruddlesden–Popper perovskite solar cells
finding: High-efficiency 2D Ruddlesden-Popper cells show layered spacer cations trade some transport for markedly improved moisture/phase stability.

title: Pseudo-halide anion engineering for α-FAPbI3 perovskite solar cells
finding: Pseudo-halide (formate) anion engineering suppresses defects and stabilizes alpha-FAPbI3, delivering certified >25% efficiency.

title: A mixed-cation lead mixed-halide perovskite absorber for tandem solar cells
finding: Mixed-cation mixed-halide (FA/Cs, I/Br) widens the gap for tandems while Cs/FA entropic mixing suppresses halide segregation and phase instability.

title: Quantum dot–induced phase stabilization of α-CsPbI <sub>3</sub> perovskite for high-efficiency photovoltaics
finding: Quantum-dot surface energy kinetically stabilizes cubic alpha-CsPbI3 at room temperature, establishing nanocrystal size as a phase-control lever.

all_themes: Phase stability; Environmental degradation; Ion migration
title: Reversible photo-induced trap formation in mixed-halide hybrid perovskites for photovoltaics
finding: Identifies reversible light-induced halide segregation (the Hoke effect) splitting mixed I/Br films into I-rich and Br-rich domains.

title: Stabilizing Perovskite Structures by Tuning Tolerance Factor: Formation of Formamidinium and Cesium Lead Iodide Solid-State Alloys
finding: Shows FA and Cs sit near opposite edges of the tolerance-factor window, so FA-Cs alloying tunes an effective t back into the stable range.

title: Intrinsic Thermal Instability of Methylammonium Lead Trihalide Perovskite
finding: Documents intrinsic thermal instability of MAPbI3 below 85 C, motivating the shift to FA/Cs compositions for phase durability.

title: Inorganic caesium lead iodide perovskite solar cells
finding: Demonstrates all-inorganic CsPbI3 cells and documents the facile black-to-yellow (alpha->delta) transition that limits inorganic absorbers.

title: New tolerance factor to predict the stability of perovskite oxides and halides
finding: A data-driven single-parameter tolerance factor tau classifies 576 ABX3 solids at ~92% accuracy, outperforming the classic Goldschmidt t for halides.

title: Methylammonium Chloride Induces Intermediate Phase Stabilization for Efficient Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Methylammonium chloride works through an intermediate phase that templates oriented, phase-pure alpha-FAPbI3 crystallization.

title: Inactive (PbI <sub>2</sub> ) <sub>2</sub> RbCl stabilizes perovskite films for efficient solar cells
finding: An inactive (PbI2)2RbCl secondary phase pins the lattice and stabilizes the photoactive perovskite for efficient, stable cells.

title: Entropic stabilization of mixed A-cation ABX <sub>3</sub> metal halide perovskites for high performance perovskite solar cells
finding: Frames mixed A-cation halides as entropically stabilized, giving a thermodynamic rationale for why cation alloys resist phase separation.

title: Efficient, stable solar cells by using inherent bandgap of α-phase formamidinium lead iodide
finding: MDACl2-assisted growth stabilizes phase-pure alpha-FAPbI3 with a near-ideal gap, giving 23.7% cells without Br/Cs bandgap widening.

title: On the application of the tolerance factor to inorganic and hybrid halide perovskites: a revised system
finding: Revises the tolerance factor specifically for inorganic and hybrid halides, improving prediction of which ABX3 halides adopt the perovskite structure.

title: Formability of ABX 3 (X = F, Cl, Br, I) halide perovskites
venue: Acta Crystallographica Section B Structural Science
finding: Maps ABX3 (X=F,Cl,Br,I) halide formability in the tolerance-factor/octahedral-factor plane, showing both geometric factors bound the perovskite-forming region.

title: Triple-halide wide–band gap perovskites with suppressed phase segregation for efficient tandems
finding: Triple-halide (Cl-alloyed) wide-bandgap perovskites suppress photoinduced halide segregation, stabilizing 1.67 eV absorbers under illumination.

title: Methylammonium-free, high-performance, and stable perovskite solar cells on a planar architecture
finding: MA-free Cs/FA compositions retain high efficiency while removing the most thermally labile cation, improving intrinsic stability.

title: 2D perovskite stabilized phase-pure formamidinium perovskite solar cells
finding: A thin 2D perovskite layer templates and stabilizes phase-pure 3D formamidinium perovskite, bridging 2D capping with alpha-phase retention.

title: Anharmonicity and Disorder in the Black Phases of Cesium Lead Iodide Used for Stable Inorganic Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: First-principles + scattering study shows anharmonic octahedral tilting underlies the metastability of the CsPbI3 alpha/beta/gamma black polymorphs.

title: Two-dimensional perovskite templates for durable, efficient formamidinium perovskite solar cells
finding: 2D perovskite templates give durable, efficient 3D cells, showing epitaxial 2D layers lock in the black phase under operational stress.

title: Preserving a robust CsPbI3 perovskite phase via pressure-directed octahedral tilt
finding: Pressure-directed octahedral tilting preserves a robust black CsPbI3 phase, linking lattice compression/strain directly to polymorph retention.

title: Bypassing the yellow phase for extremely stable formamidinium lead iodide perovskite solar cells
finding: Bypasses the yellow delta-phase intermediate during crystallization to yield extremely stable formamidinium perovskite cells (2026 frontier).

title: Improved air stability of perovskite solar cells via solution-processed metal oxide transport layers
finding: Metal-oxide charge-transport layers markedly improve air stability of perovskite cells, implicating interfaces/contacts in environmental degradation.

title: Overcoming ultraviolet light instability of sensitized TiO2 with meso-superstructured organometal tri-halide perovskite solar cells
finding: UV illumination of TiO2 electron-transport layers triggers photocatalytic degradation; replacing/insulating TiO2 mitigates UV instability.

title: Consensus statement for stability assessment and reporting for perovskite photovoltaics based on ISOS procedures
finding: ISOS consensus protocols standardize how moisture, thermal, light and operational stress tests are run and reported for perovskite devices.

title: Formamidinium and Cesium Hybridization for Photo‐ and Moisture‐Stable Perovskite Solar Cell
finding: FA/Cs cation mixing yields perovskites with improved photo- and moisture-stability versus MA-based analogues, a compositional route to durability.

title: Transformation of the Excited State and Photovoltaic Efficiency of CH3NH3PbI3 Perovskite upon Controlled Exposure to Humidified Air
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: Moderate humidified air can transiently boost then degrade MAPbI3 performance; water intercalation is initially reversible before hydrate/PbI2 formation.

title: Reversible Hydration of CH3NH3PbI3 in Films, Single Crystals, and Solar Cells
finding: MAPbI3 reversibly forms mono- then dihydrate on humidity exposure; prolonged water drives irreversible decomposition to PbI2.

title: Investigation of CH3NH3PbI3 Degradation Rates and Mechanisms in Controlled Humidity Environments Using in Situ Techniques
finding: Direct real-time imaging of MAPbI3 hydrate formation and PbI2 conversion, resolving humidity-dependent degradation rates and pathways.

title: Fast oxygen diffusion and iodide defects mediate oxygen-induced degradation of perovskite solar cells
finding: Iodide vacancies mediate fast O2 diffusion and superoxide formation; defect density controls photo-oxidation rate, linking defects to environmental attack.

title: Light and oxygen induced degradation limits the operational stability of methylammonium lead triiodide perovskite solar cells
finding: Combined light + O2 (not moisture alone) limits operational MAPbI3 device stability; superoxide-driven decomposition dominates in air under illumination.

title: The Role of Oxygen in the Degradation of Methylammonium Lead Trihalide Perovskite Photoactive Layers
finding: Molecular O2 plus light generates superoxide that deprotonates MA+ and decomposes MAPbI3; establishes photo-oxidation as a distinct O2-driven channel.

title: Scaling behavior of moisture-induced grain degradation in polycrystalline hybrid perovskite thin films
finding: Moisture-induced degradation nucleates at grain boundaries and scales with grain-boundary density, identifying microstructure as a moisture-stability lever.

title: Origin of Reversible Photoinduced Phase Separation in Hybrid Perovskites
finding: Polaron-strain model for reversible photoinduced phase separation: carrier-lattice coupling drives halide demixing, explaining reversibility.

title: Photodecomposition and thermal decomposition in methylammonium halide lead perovskites and inferred design principles to increase photovoltaic device stability
finding: Distinguishes thermal from photochemical decomposition of MA perovskites; identifies gaseous products (CH3NH2, HI vs. NH3, CH3I) diagnostic of each route.

title: Rationalizing the light-induced phase separation of mixed halide organic–inorganic perovskites
finding: Photoinduced halide segregation is governed by carrier density/thermodynamics; illumination intensity and composition set the segregation threshold.

title: Thermal degradation of formamidinium based lead halide perovskites into sym -triazine and hydrogen cyanide observed by coupled thermogravimetry-mass spectrometry analysis
finding: FA-based perovskites thermally decompose via sym-triazine and other volatile products, showing FA is not immune to cation-loss pathways.

title: The role of halide oxidation in perovskite halide phase separation
finding: Halide (iodide) oxidation to I2/I3- is a chemical driver of light-induced phase separation, coupling redox chemistry to segregation.

title: Water-Accelerated Photooxidation of CH3NH3PbI3 Perovskite
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: Trace water dramatically accelerates photo-oxidation of MAPbI3, revealing a light+O2+H2O synergy beyond either agent alone.

title: Ionic transport in hybrid lead iodide perovskite solar cells
finding: DFT+experiment establish iodide vacancy migration (~0.58 eV) as the dominant transport channel in MAPbI3, seeding the field's mechanistic picture.

title: Anomalous Hysteresis in Perovskite Solar Cells
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
finding: Identifies anomalous J-V hysteresis in perovskite cells and proposes slow ionic/defect processes as a leading cause.

title: Ion Migration in Organometal Trihalide Perovskite and Its Impact on Photovoltaic Efficiency and Stability
finding: Review synthesizing evidence that mobile ions drive hysteresis, switchable photovoltaics, and giant dielectric response.

title: Defect migration in methylammonium lead iodide and its role in perovskite solar cell operation
finding: First-principles defect migration in MAPbI3 finds iodide the most mobile species and links its motion to hysteresis.

title: Grain boundary dominated ion migration in polycrystalline organic–inorganic halide perovskite films
finding: Direct imaging shows ion migration is dominated by grain boundaries in polycrystalline films, far faster than through bulk grains.

title: Cation and anion immobilization through chemical bonding enhancement with fluorides for stable halide perovskite solar cells
finding: Cation and anion immobilization via chemical-bond enhancement suppresses migration and boosts operational stability.

title: First-Principles Study of Ion Diffusion in Perovskite Solar Cell Sensitizers
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: First-principles ion-diffusion study confirms the iodide vacancy as lowest-barrier migrating defect and maps concerted pathways.

title: Migration of cations induces reversible performance losses over day/night cycling in perovskite solar cells
finding: Distinguishes fast reversible from slow cation-migration-induced performance losses over hours of operation, an interfacial-accumulation signature.

title: Iodine chemistry determines the defect tolerance of lead-halide perovskites
finding: Iodine redox chemistry (I-rich vs I-poor) governs which deep vs shallow defects form, explaining perovskite defect tolerance.

title: Self‐Regulation Mechanism for Charged Point Defects in Hybrid Halide Perovskites
finding: Self-regulation of charged point defects keeps Fermi level pinned and native defects mostly shallow — the basis of defect tolerance.

title: Rethinking the A cation in halide perovskites
finding: Rethinking the A-cation: bulky guanidinium-type cations raise the iodide-migration barrier, the 'pinning' concept central to the project.

title: Phase segregation due to ion migration in all-inorganic mixed-halide perovskite nanocrystals
finding: Demonstrates ion-migration-driven phase segregation in all-inorganic mixed-halide CsPb(I/Br)3, linking it to vacancy motion.

title: Quantification of ion migration in CH 3 NH 3 PbI 3 perovskite solar cells by transient capacitance measurements
finding: Transient ion-drift measurements quantify densities and activation energies of migrating species, separating cation from anion motion.

title: Suppressing ion migration in metal halide perovskite via interstitial doping with a trace amount of multivalent cations
finding: Interstitial doping immobilizes mobile halides, raising migration barriers and suppressing ion transport (project anchor).

title: Intrinsic Point Defects in Inorganic Cesium Lead Iodide Perovskite CsPbI3
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
finding: Intrinsic point-defect calculations in inorganic CsPbI3 identify dominant vacancies/interstitials and their charge states — directly the project's system.

title: A multiscale ion diffusion framework sheds light on the diffusion–stability–hysteresis nexus in metal halide perovskites
finding: Multiscale framework reconciles wide barrier scatter by showing grain boundaries and morphology set effective diffusion, not single-crystal barriers.

title: Ion Migration at Metal Halide Perovskite Grain Boundaries Elucidated with a Machine Learning Force Field
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
finding: Machine-learning force field resolves ion migration at perovskite grain boundaries with near-DFT accuracy at MD length/time scales.

title: Tracing Ion Migration in Halide Perovskites with Machine Learned Force Fields
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
finding: Machine-learned force field traces ion-migration trajectories and barrier distributions in halide perovskites across charge states.

title: Ion migration in perovskite solar cells
finding: Recent review consolidating ion-migration mechanisms, measurement, and mitigation in perovskite solar cells.

title: Ion Migration and Dopant Effects in the Gamma-CsPbI3 Perovskite Photovoltaic Material: Atomistic Insights through Ab Initio and Machine Learning Methods
finding: MLIP-driven NEB quantifies dopant effects on iodide-vacancy migration in gamma-CsPbI3 — the project's exact methodology and system.

title: A Unified microscopic picture of cation and anion migration in MAPbI$_3$
finding: Unified MLIP picture of both cation and anion migration in MAPbI3, extending force-field migration studies to full ion inventory.

title: Impact of strain relaxation on performance of α-formamidinium lead iodide perovskite solar cells
finding: Relaxing residual strain in α-FAPbI₃ suppresses the transition to the photoinactive δ-phase, stabilizing the black perovskite and boosting device performance.

title: Strain engineering in perovskite solar cells and its impacts on carrier dynamics
finding: Depth-dependent GIXRD reveals a gradient of in-plane residual strain; strain-induced band bending (DFT) governs carrier dynamics, and controlled strain modulation yields 20.7% certified PCE.

title: Strained hybrid perovskite thin films and their impact on the intrinsic stability of perovskite solar cells
finding: Landmark demonstration that MAPbI₃ films are residually strained relative to substrates from thermal-expansion mismatch during annealing, degrading intrinsic stability.

title: Band Gap Tuning via Lattice Contraction and Octahedral Tilting in Perovskite Materials for Photovoltaics
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: Lattice contraction and octahedral tilting (via A/B-cation size) tune bandgap and phase behaviour, establishing the composition→lattice→property link underpinning strain design.

title: Light-induced lattice expansion leads to high-efficiency perovskite solar cells
finding: Light-soaking drives a reversible ~0.1–0.3% lattice expansion that relaxes local strain at grain boundaries/interfaces, uniformly raising efficiency across architectures.

title: Strain engineering and epitaxial stabilization of halide perovskites
finding: Epitaxial growth on lattice-mismatched single-crystal substrates imposes controllable compressive/tensile strain and stabilizes otherwise-metastable halide-perovskite phases.

title: Regulating strain in perovskite thin films through charge-transport layers
finding: Compressive strain injected from a high-thermal-expansion HTL compensates residual tensile strain, raising the ion-migration activation energy; 16.4% wide-bandgap cell keeps 96% after 85 °C/1000 h.

title: Strain analysis and engineering in halide perovskite photovoltaics
finding: Reference review defining strain analysis (GIWAXS, XRD sin²ψ, Williamson–Hall) and engineering routes; frames residual strain as an intrinsic, encapsulation-immune instability channel.

title: Lattice strain causes non-radiative losses in halide perovskites
finding: Spatially-resolved strain patterns across films correlate with shortened carrier lifetimes, directly tying local lattice strain to non-radiative recombination losses.

title: Interfacial Residual Stress Relaxation in Perovskite Solar Cells with Improved Stability
finding: Interfacial residual tensile stress relaxed by a strain-releasing interlayer, improving both efficiency and operational/thermal stability of the device stack.

title: Synergistic strain engineering of perovskite single crystals for highly stable and sensitive X-ray detectors with low-bias imaging and monitoring
finding: Synergistic strain engineering in perovskite single crystals reduces defect density and enhances stability, extending strain control beyond polycrystalline films.

title: Strain effects on halide perovskite solar cells
finding: Comprehensive review linking tensile/compressive strain to ion migration, defect formation, halide segregation and phase stability across the strain-effect landscape.

title: Strain in perovskite solar cells: origins, impacts and regulation
finding: Review establishing that residual tensile strain — unlike moisture/heat — cannot be countered by encapsulation, and surveys origins, characterization and regulation.

title: Elimination of Interfacial Lattice Mismatch and Detrimental Reaction by Self‐Assembled Layer Dual‐Passivation for Efficient and Stable Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Eliminating interfacial lattice mismatch removes a strain source and a detrimental interfacial reaction, improving stability of the perovskite/charge-transport junction.

title: Revealing the strain-associated physical mechanisms impacting the performance and stability of perovskite solar cells
finding: Resolves the microscopic mechanisms by which residual strain degrades performance, connecting lattice distortion to defect populations and transport.

title: Revealing Steric‐Hindrance‐Dependent Buried Interface Defect Passivation Mechanism in Efficient and Stable Perovskite Solar Cells with Mitigated Tensile Stress
finding: Steric-hindrance-tuned molecular passivation at the buried interface simultaneously relieves interfacial lattice strain and passivates defects.

title: Lattice Compression Increases the Activation Barrier for Phase Segregation in Mixed-Halide Perovskites
finding: Hydrostatic lattice compression raises the activation barrier for photoinduced halide segregation in mixed-halide films — direct evidence that compressive strain suppresses phase separation.

title: Strain regulation retards natural operation decay of perovskite solar cells
finding: Under day/night cycling, periodic thermal strain (absent in continuous-mode tests) drives trap accumulation and chemical decay; phenylselenenyl chloride regulates strain for 26.3% certified PCE and 10× T80 improvement.

title: Strain Engineering in Halide Perovskites
finding: Early framing review cataloguing strain sources (thermal-mismatch, lattice-mismatch, composition) and their coupling to optoelectronic and stability properties.

title: Strain Modulation for Light‐Stable n–i–p Perovskite/Silicon Tandem Solar Cells
finding: Strain modulation produces light-stable n–i–p perovskite/silicon tandem sub-cells, mitigating photoinduced strain-driven degradation in wide-bandgap tops.

title: Strain Control to Stabilize Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Demonstrates strain control as a general handle to stabilize perovskite solar cells against operational stressors.

title: The influence of strain on phase stability in mixed-halide perovskites
finding: Systematic study showing applied strain shifts the thermodynamics/kinetics of halide phase separation in mixed-halide perovskites, coupling strain state to compositional stability.

title: Taming Lattice Strain via Buried Interface Engineering for Reverse-Bias Resilient Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Identifies the buried HTL/perovskite interface as the principal strain-accumulation site; a fluorinated anchor (3F-2TC) relieves strain (GIWAXS-confirmed), giving 26.10% PCE and 91.58% retention after 200 h at −1.0 V reverse bias.

title: Surface passivation of perovskite film for efficient solar cells
finding: PEAI surface treatment on FA-rich films passivates surface defects, boosting Voc and certified efficiency while improving ambient stability — the canonical ammonium-halide surface passivation.

title: One-Year stable perovskite solar cells by 2D/3D interface engineering
finding: Seminal 2D/3D interface engineering with aminovaleric-acid template yields one-year-stable devices; the 2D layer acts as a moisture-tolerant protective capping.

title: Imperfections and their passivation in halide perovskite solar cells
finding: Foundational review classifying perovskite defects and their passivation; frames undercoordinated Pb/I and halide vacancies as the dominant non-radiative and instability centers.

title: Maximizing and stabilizing luminescence from halide perovskites with potassium passivation
finding: Potassium passivation immobilizes excess halides at grain boundaries/surfaces, eliminating halide-vacancy-mediated hysteresis and stabilizing luminescence — a mechanistic keystone.

title: Constructive molecular configurations for surface-defect passivation of perovskite photovoltaics
finding: Theophylline/caffeine/theobromine passivators: an optimal molecular configuration (carbonyl + amine H-bond donors) maximizes binding to undercoordinated Pb and defect passivation.

title: Managing grains and interfaces via ligand anchoring enables 22.3%-efficiency inverted perovskite solar cells
finding: Long-chain ligand anchoring manages grains and interfaces, passivating boundary defects to reach 22.3% with improved stability.

title: Universal Approach toward Hysteresis-Free Perovskite Solar Cell via Defect Engineering
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: KI addition gives hysteresis-free devices by having K+/I- fill halide vacancies and immobilize mobile iodide, improving operational stability.

title: Rational design of Lewis base molecules for stable and efficient inverted perovskite solar cells
finding: Rational design of Lewis-base molecules for inverted cells; tuning donor atom and steric profile optimizes defect binding for simultaneously high efficiency and stability.

title: Deterministic fabrication of 3D/2D perovskite bilayer stacks for durable and efficient solar cells
finding: Deterministically grown 3D/2D bilayer stacks provide durable operation under heat, light and bias by stabilizing the 3D surface with an epitaxial 2D cap.

title: Large guanidinium cation mixed with methylammonium in lead iodide perovskites for 19% efficient solar cells
finding: Seminal guanidinium incorporation into MAPbI3: GA+ H-bonds to the iodide cage, raising carrier lifetimes and materially improving thermal/operational stability.

title: Engineering ligand reactivity enables high-temperature operation of stable perovskite solar cells
finding: Engineering ligand reactivity yields surface layers stable at high temperature, enabling durable operation under thermal stress.

title: Tailoring passivators for highly efficient and stable perovskite solar cells
finding: Recent review systematizing passivator design rules (Lewis base/acid, ionic, multifunctional) linking molecular structure to both efficiency and operational stability.

title: Atomic-level passivation mechanism of ammonium salts enabling highly efficient perovskite solar cells
finding: Combined experiment/DFT shows ammonium salts passivate via hydrogen bonding of NH-groups to surface halides, suppressing halide-vacancy states and improving stability.

title: Interstitial Occupancy by Extrinsic Alkali Cations in Perovskites and Its Impact on Ion Migration
finding: Extrinsic alkali cations (K/Rb) occupy interstitial sites rather than A-sites, explaining their defect-immobilizing action and stabilization of the lattice.

title: Two birds with one stone: dual grain-boundary and interface passivation enables >22% efficient inverted methylammonium-free perovskite solar cells
finding: Dual grain-boundary and interface passivation ('two birds, one stone') with a single additive suppresses recombination and improves wide-bandgap-cell stability.

title: Dopant-additive synergism enhances perovskite solar modules
finding: Dopant-additive synergism translates to perovskite solar modules with enhanced stability, showing molecular passivation scales beyond small cells.

title: Ammonium cations with high pKa in perovskite solar cells for improved high-temperature photostability
finding: High-pKa ammonium cations resist deprotonation, giving more robust surface passivation and markedly improved operational and thermal stability in inverted cells.

title: Synergy of 3D and 2D Perovskites for Durable, Efficient Solar Cells and Beyond
finding: Chemical Reviews synthesis of how 3D+2D synergy delivers durability: the 2D capping suppresses ion migration and moisture ingress while passivating the surface.

title: How machine learning can help select capping layers to suppress perovskite degradation
finding: Data-driven screening of A-site cations for capping layers identifies molecular descriptors that predict which capping molecules best suppress degradation.

title: Inhibiting Ion Migration by Guanidinium Cation Doping for Efficient Perovskite Solar Cells with Enhanced Operational Stability
finding: Guanidinium doping directly suppresses ion migration (higher activation energy) via strong hydrogen bonding, reducing hysteresis and improving stability.

title: Monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem solar cell with >29% efficiency by enhanced hole extraction
finding: 2PACz-family self-assembled-monolayer hole contacts enable >29% inverted tandems and became the standard stable p-i-n contact.

title: Understanding Degradation Mechanisms and Improving Stability of Perovskite Photovoltaics
finding: Comprehensive mechanistic review connecting intrinsic/extrinsic degradation pathways to concrete device stabilization strategies.

title: Improved charge extraction in inverted perovskite solar cells with dual-site-binding ligands
finding: Dual-site-binding ligands improve charge extraction and operational stability of inverted cells.

title: Not All That Glitters Is Gold: Metal-Migration-Induced Degradation in Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Gold electrode migrates through the HTL into the absorber under thermal stress, causing irreversible metal-migration degradation.

title: Tailored interfaces of unencapsulated perovskite solar cells for >1,000 hour operational stability
finding: Tailored transport-layer interfaces sustain >1,000 h operation in unencapsulated cells, isolating interfacial degradation as decisive.

title: Damp heat–stable perovskite solar cells with tailored-dimensionality 2D/3D heterojunctions
finding: Tailored-dimensionality 2D/3D heterojunctions yield damp-heat-stable cells passing the IEC 61215:2016 damp-heat test.

title: Stabilized hole-selective layer for high-performance inverted p-i-n perovskite solar cells
finding: Stabilized hole-selective layer delivers high-performance, operationally stable inverted p-i-n cells.

title: Long-term operating stability in perovskite photovoltaics
finding: Review separating intrinsic operational (light+bias) degradation from shelf/thermal stability and mapping dominant MPP-operation loss channels.

title: Lessons learned from spiro-OMeTAD and PTAA in perovskite solar cells
finding: Ionic dopants/additives in spiro-OMeTAD and PTAA drive instability; guides design of durable organic hole contacts.

title: Towards commercialization: the operational stability of perovskite solar cells
finding: Frames operational stability as the commercialization bottleneck; catalogues bias/light/thermal degradation and stack-wide mitigations.

title: Reinforcing self-assembly of hole transport molecules for stable inverted perovskite solar cells
finding: Anti-desorption anchoring reinforces SAM self-assembly, suppressing the SAM-detachment failure mode of inverted cells.

title: Gas chromatography–mass spectrometry analyses of encapsulated stable perovskite solar cells
finding: GC-MS-guided encapsulation controls outgassing for stable operation and limits lead leakage under mechanical damage.

title: Design and understanding of encapsulated perovskite solar cells to withstand temperature cycling
finding: Rationally designed encapsulation lets cells survive IEC 61215 damp-heat and thermal-cycling accelerated aging.

title: Development of encapsulation strategies towards the commercialization of perovskite solar cells
finding: Reviews encapsulation-barrier strategies (edge seals, desiccants, barrier films) required to move perovskite cells toward commercial module stability.

title: An open-access database and analysis tool for perovskite solar cells based on the FAIR data principles
finding: Open-access Perovskite Database (>42k devices) enables data-driven meta-analysis of stability trends and exposes reporting inconsistencies.

title: Interplay between temperature and bandgap energies on the outdoor performance of perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells
finding: Outdoor field data reveal temperature-bandgap interplay governs real energy yield and degradation of perovskite and tandem devices.

title: Towards linking lab and field lifetimes of perovskite solar cells
finding: Combined accelerated indoor protocols are shown to predict field degradation, beginning to bridge the lab-to-field lifetime gap.

title: Barrier Design to Prevent Metal-Induced Degradation and Improve Thermal Stability in Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Inserting a diffusion-barrier interlayer blocks metal-electrode-induced degradation and improves thermal stability.

title: Ion-induced field screening as a dominant factor in perovskite solar cell operational stability
finding: Mobile-ion accumulation screens the built-in field under operation — a dominant, partly reversible performance-loss factor distinct from recombination.

title: The long road to outdoor stability: real-world challenges for controlling perovskite materials for solar cells
finding: 2026 review of real-world outdoor-stability challenges and the persistent gap between accelerated indoor tests and field deployment.

title: A climbing image nudged elastic band method for finding saddle points and minimum energy paths
finding: Climbing-image NEB locates saddle points and migration barriers; the standard method for computing E_a in solids.

title: First-principles calculations for point defects in solids
finding: Authoritative review of first-principles charged-defect formalism: formation energies, chemical potentials, corrections, functional/SOC choices.

title: Unusual defect physics in CH3NH3PbI3 perovskite solar cell absorber
finding: Foundational DFT showing MAPbI3 has only shallow, low-formation-energy defects — the origin of perovskite 'defect tolerance'.

title: E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for data-efficient and accurate interatomic potentials
finding: NequIP: E(3)-equivariant GNN achieving DFT accuracy with orders-of-magnitude less training data.

title: Fully Ab Initio Finite-Size Corrections for Charged-Defect Supercell Calculations
finding: Introduces the ab initio (FNV) electrostatic correction removing spurious periodic-image interactions for charged defects.

title: A universal graph deep learning interatomic potential for the periodic table
finding: M3GNet universal potential covering the periodic table, enabling relaxation/MD of arbitrary crystals.

title: CHGNet as a pretrained universal neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling
finding: CHGNet: charge-informed universal potential encoding magnetic moments/charge states for redox-active MD.

title: Accelerated discovery of stable lead-free hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites via machine learning
finding: ML-accelerated HT screening of hybrid double perovskites for thermodynamic stability and band gap.

title: Electrostatics-based finite-size corrections for first-principles point defect calculations
finding: Kumagai-Oba extension of FNV to anisotropic systems using atomic-site potential alignment — widely used for perovskites.

title: A foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry
finding: MACE-MP-0 foundation model: one pretrained MLIP for MD across the periodic table.

title: A framework to evaluate machine learning crystal stability predictions
finding: Matbench Discovery: community benchmark ranking universal MLIPs on stability prediction; exposes over-stabilization biases.

title: Systematic softening in universal machine learning interatomic potentials
finding: Systematic softening: universal MLIPs underestimate forces and energy barriers; fine-tuning/loss reweighting mitigates it.

title: Performance Assessment of Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Challenges and Directions for Materials’ Surfaces
finding: Assessment showing universal MLIPs (M3GNet, CHGNet, MACE) reproduce trends but with systematic errors on defect/surface energetics.

title: Latent Ewald summation for machine learning of long-range interactions
finding: Latent Ewald summation captures long-range electrostatics in MLIPs at near-linear cost — critical for charged defects.

title: How fast do defects migrate in halide perovskites: insights from on-the-fly machine-learned force fields
finding: MLIP-driven MD quantifying how fast vacancies migrate in halide perovskites at finite temperature.

title: The Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) inorganic materials dataset and models
finding: OMat24: >100M-structure dataset with non-equilibrium/rattled configs improving foundation-model force accuracy.

title: Multi-fidelity Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Charged Point Defects
finding: Multi-fidelity MLIP scheme injecting charged-defect electrostatics to fix long-range errors for defect migration.

title: MACE: Higher Order Equivariant Message Passing Neural Networks for Fast and Accurate Force Fields
finding: MACE higher-order equivariant message passing — the architecture underlying the perovskite MLIP spine.

title: Evaluation of Foundational Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials for Migration Barrier Predictions
finding: Benchmarks five foundation MLIPs (MACE-MP-0, Orb-v3, SevenNet, CHGNet, M3GNet) coupled to NEB against DFT-NEB migration barriers across battery/ionic-conductor chemistries; MACE-MP-0 and Orb-v3 lowest-error, and barrier accuracy found uncorrelated with geometry accuracy.
